items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change itself is short and readable: `or (hasattr(queryset, "query") and queryset.query.is_sliced)` with a clear error message. However, it adds the opposite of the requested behavior, which hurts how well the code shows its intent for this issue.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It changes a shared error message, which broke existing P2P tests test_raw_queryset and test_values_queryset. It also edited existing tests, which the task forbade. It turns a requested feature into a permanent ValueError instead of adding the helper in related_descriptors.py.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The input check at the Prefetch boundary is explicit and fails loudly with a ValueError, and no errors are swallowed. But it blocks a valid use case instead of supporting it.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: No per-parent slicing was implemented. Prefetch now raises ValueError for any sliced queryset (`Prefetch("houses", House.objects.all()[:1])`). There is no Window/RowNumber partitioning and no handling of low/high marks. All 4 F2P PrefetchLimitTests fail.
